confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: {name} ({address}) declares {count} writable object(s). Home Assistant will create entities for them alongside the sensors it already reads from this device.

abort.not_supported: This is an ordinary BTHome device: it does not declare any of its objects as writable, so there is nothing for this integration to do. Its sensors are handled by the BTHome integration.
abort.nothing_writable: This device carries a writability declaration, but it marks no usable object.
abort.no_devices_found: Writable BTHome devices announce themselves. If yours has not appeared, Home Assistant cannot currently receive its advertising — check that it is in range of an adapter or a Bluetooth proxy.
